as_told.title: Coulthart on the MJ12 document's 28 June 1961 date

plain: A document from the MJ-12 papers, a disputed set of files said to come from a secret group handling UFO matters, describes a top secret request from President John F. Kennedy to CIA director Allen Dulles on 28 June 1961 for a review. Michels says it leaked in 1995 and was recently discussed on the news channel NewsNation by the journalist Ross Coulthart and a former Australian intelligence officer named Jeff Cruickshank, who set it beside Allen Dulles's diary, released with the JFK files in 2022. Coulthart, telling it himself, stresses that the MJ-12 files are "very disputed"; if the document were genuine, it would place a UFO inquiry on a president's desk.
